answer: Marble ledger: each agent locks 150 POA and needs countersignatures from three peers who answered distinct past epochs. Witnesses stake 100 POA each; a shared wallet, reused device key, or repeated witness triad slashes 75 POA per witness and burns the submitter's 150 POA bond. One hundred clones need three hundred distinct witnesses and 30,000 POA locked, with 15,000 POA slashed at first detection. Fresh identities wait in the haven queue with zero weight for two clean epochs. Walnut rule: one bond per device key — clones cracking the shell share one rotten core.
